results.title: reddit.com: api documentation
results.snippet: Many endpoints on reddit use the same protocol for controlling pagination and filtering. These endpoints are called Listings and share five common parameters: after / before, limit, count, and show. Listings do not use page numbers because their content changes so frequently.

results.title: Advanced Reddit Search Filters API (2026)
results.snippet: Filter Reddit search by score, comments, media type, and NSFW over one GET. Every filter parameter, the response meta, and copy-paste Python examples.

results.title: r/redditsync on Reddit: An Update Regarding Reddit’s API - changes to how third party apps access NSFW content
results.snippet: Reddit will limit access to mature content via our Data API as part of an ongoing effort to provide guardrails to how sexually explicit content and communities on Reddit are discovered and viewed.

results.title: Reddit Keyword Filter - Chrome Web Store
results.snippet: Very simple extension that lets you add keywords to filter posts (by title) on Reddit, also lets you filter out ads. There are some pre-defined keywords for politics, but you can manage the keywords in any way you would like.
